Strong recognisable silhouette filling about 27x27 logical pixels with 2-3 pixels of safety margin. Main material planes in 3-4 connected large stepped colour clusters, at most 12-18 controlled palette colours. One main colour family and one small themed accent. Readable clean bevels and modest shadow, sharp connected pixel shapes. Shape and colour communicate category and theme, strong enough to read in a small inventory slot. No text, no background, no character, no scenery, no particles, no fog, no aura, no smooth rendering, no realistic gradients, no anti-aliasing, no filigree or jewellery spread over every surface, no scattered white glints, no noisy micro-detail. Use broad plates or cloth areas and a small clear set emblem; a recognisable empty helmet/chestplate/pair of leggings/pair of boots as appropriate.  Subject:  风暴鹰眼胸甲.
